summary: Frontend-only regression of Intl Shipments detail view (IS-0011/0012/0010). All specified detail-view features work: breadcrumb + is-back navigation, hero with monogram avatars (SA / HH) and route line, 5 fact tiles (Ship date+chip, Mode·Incoterms Air/FOB·USD, Units 700 · 2 lines, Declared $6,370, Prepayment $3,182.50 50% of value), numbered 7-step stepper, segmented ops-seg tabs, Parties card with copy-to-clipboard and icon buttons, Prepayment card with progress bar + paid/outstanding legend, activity timeline with title/timestamp/detail/avatar+author. is-hero-message switches to Conversation tab. is-advance ('Mark prepaid') correctly advances: chips collapse to 'Prepaid', 'Blocked on payment' chip disappears, step 5 becomes 'now/In progress', prepayment fact tile switches class 'a'→'g' with '· received' label. Booking tab shows Received chip, 50% progress bar, legend $3,182.50 paid / $3,187.50 outstanding. IS-0012 (Prepaid) and IS-0010 (Shipped) detail pages open cleanly. No horizontal overflow at 1920x800. No console errors when clipboard permission granted.

integration_issues.issue: navigator.clipboard.writeText() promise rejection is unhandled when browser denies clipboard permission (e.g., insecure/iframe context). This surfaces CRA 'Uncaught runtime error' overlay covering the UI. The toast still fires but the overlay blocks further interaction until dismissed. Wrap with .catch() or try/catch and toast an error instead.

action_items: Add .catch() to both navigator.clipboard?.writeText(...) calls in Detail() (is-copy-buyer and factory email copy) to prevent unhandled promise rejection surfacing as a runtime error overlay when clipboard access is denied. Example: navigator.clipboard?.writeText(s.buyer).then(() => toast('Email copied')).catch(() => toast('Copy failed','error'));
critical_code_review_comments: IntlShipmentsPage.tsx is 429 lines and contains both list and Detail components; consider splitting Detail into its own file for maintainability.
Clipboard writes are fire-and-forget without error handling — will crash dev overlay in restricted contexts.
